 TNN / Nov 16, 2026, 01:34 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Lucknow: Govt extended the deadline to apply under Lucknow Municipal Corporation’s one-time settlement (OTS) scheme for property tax and water-related dues to Dec 14. Property owners can deposit the settlement amount and complete the process by Jan 15, 2027, under the revised schedule. The scheme covers pending house tax dues as well as water tax, sewer tax and water charges owed to the Jal Kal department. LMC’s three-month OTS scheme received 24,920 applications and generated Rs 24.82 crore in collections, while taxpayers received interest relief of Rs 10.31 crore, according to civic body data. A total of 10,640 taxpayers cleared their pending dues under the scheme, the data showed.
